provenance.selected_run: The successful offline Base64 candidate evaluation after the earlier network-fetch attempt stopped before model calls.
provenance.transport: Public candidate source downloaded and SHA256-checked on m5, then transferred as Base64 argv into the independent docker-exec evaluation process.

limitations: This file records terminal evidence, not the unseen full JSON model report. Only the two printed candidate failure tuples are stored as individual predictions.
Validated model summaries, facts, quoted_numbers, full responses, resolved upstream model ID, token usage and timings were not present in the supplied stdout and are not invented here.
The legacy runner printed the numeric-verification metric as 幻觉率. It verifies only the model-declared quoted_numbers against source text and does not establish absence of all semantic hallucinations.
The --no-judge run did not measure independent fact coverage.
The 24 synthetic samples do not establish real-mail accuracy.
The nonzero qualification exit under set -e skipped the subsequent report cat command. The helper stated that the report and TSV had already been saved.
The evaluation process did not read/write the mailbox database or replace running service source; it did not deploy the candidate or reclassify historical mail.

per_sample_regressions.evidence: The stored @5 baseline classified the roles of these two samples correctly. Candidate stdout shows both becoming wrong despite improved aggregate trade_role accuracy.
